name: Canonical Echo
palette_logic: symbolic but limited; one dominant card color plus two support colors
composition_bias: keep one to three anchor symbols readable
texture_language: light paper grain, hand-touched but not distressed
border_system: thin title border with rank/suit marks
typography_system: small roman title, high contrast, no decorative excess

name: Archetype Abstract
medium: geometric color field and symbolic cut paper
line_language: clean edges, large shapes, minimal contour
palette_logic: emotion-led palettes with one tension color
composition_bias: turn the card into a psychological force or relation
border_system: quiet border, card title integrated as label

name: Ritual Object
medium: crafted still life, metal, cloth, glass, paper
line_language: object edges and tactile surface detail
palette_logic: material-first palette from the selected objects
composition_bias: express the card through altar-like object relationships
texture_language: tactile, precise, photographed-object logic without stock-photo mood
border_system: object shadow inside a stable card frame
negative_constraints: no cultural sacred objects as decoration

name: Emotional Weather
palette_logic: weather and season carry emotional tone
composition_bias: make the card meaning feel like a climate or pressure system
border_system: minimal border so atmosphere reaches the edge
